verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison's Literature agent searches a dedicated scholarly corpus of over 175M papers, clinical trials and patents. It understands citation graphs and journal quality, and returns cited answers traceable to specific literature passages, which is scholarly and primary-source search rather than open-web search. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of corpus coverage and retrieval quality, documentation of which specific databases or sources make up the corpus.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can search scholarly literature and primary sources, not just the open web

citations.quote: Literature handles search and synthesis tasks with high accuracy, drawing from over 175 million papers, trials, and patents.
It accesses 175M+ papers, trials, and patents with native understanding of citation graphs, journal quality, and clinical trial data.
You can trace any finding back to the specific code or literature passage that produced it.
